author: More Perfect Union
description:
NEW: The Senate is on the verge of passing the "Protect College Sports Act" after lobbying from Amazon, Disney, Paramount and more.

The bill would cap player compensation, but fails to address massive coach salaries, buyouts, or private equity.

Actual college athletes have been left out of the process, so while the NCAA would get an anti-trust exemption, players wouldn't get a seat at the table.

We talked to Stanford football players to learn more.

Producer: @jjcimp
Editor: @discosludge
Videographers: Joel Van Haren, Marc Davies
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: These college football players would like a word with Ted Cruz

description:
Regular people are losing the right to fish in Alaska.

Corporations discard millions of pounds of fish every year while people lose access to rivers, and the media is sleeping on the story.

Now the working class is fighting back, and their rage could flip the US Senate.

Host & Producer: Liz Scheltens
Editor & Motion Designer: Ian McKenna
Field Producers: Gabe Derrick & Graham Merwin

Video Production Manager: Isabel Atalaya

Video Production Fellow: Astrid Dong
Video Editing Fellow: Daria Nastasia
Supervising Producer: Sam Quigley

More Perfect Union is an Emmy-winning, nonprofit newsroom whose mission is to build power for working people. Here’s what that means: We report on the real struggles and challenges of the working class from a working-class perspective. We attempt to connect those problems to potential solutions. We report on the abuses and wrongdoing of corporate power.
title: We Went to Alaska. The Fishing Crisis Will Shock You
